#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long n,b[20];
unordered_map<long long, unordered_map<int, long long>> memo;

long long dfs(long long x, int sum) {
    if (memo[x].count(sum)) return memo[x][sum];
    long long num = x / b[sum];
    long long rem = x % b[sum];
    if (rem == 0) return memo[x][sum] = num * sum;
    long long left = dfs(rem, sum-1);
    long long right = sum + dfs(b[sum]-rem, sum-1);
    return memo[x][sum] = num * sum + min(left, right);
}

int main() {
    cin >> n;
    for (int i=1; i<=17; i++) b[i] = b[i-1]*10ll + 1ll;
    long long m=0, x=n;
    while (x) { x/=10; m++; }
    cout << dfs(n, m+2) << endl;
    return 0;
}
